criteria: Fix ordered endpoint pairs, qualifier/reference meanings and the independently stated graph invariant against the captured source slice.
Record semantic/reviewer ownership, the required general soundness statement and the conditions under which the slice has an inhabited valid graph.
Treat the existing companion schemas and APIs as draft projections to be aligned after formalization.
Typed identities, exact ordered signatures, qualifiers, references and the graph invariant have independent formal definitions.
The intended theorem quantifies over arbitrary finite supported inputs; all source-interpretation and external-evidence assumptions are explicit.
The reference checker consumes the formal typed input directly and has no dependency on JSON decoding or host runtime integration.
Meaningful valid and invalid Lean examples exercise exact pairs, qualifiers, references and the selected graph invariant.
Lean checks the exact general theorem with the pinned D00 toolchain and an audited dependency/axiom closure.
Check at least one inhabited valid formal graph so the selected use case is not vacuous.
Review accepts independent semantics and proof scope, including explicit source, parser, hash and compiled-runtime trust boundaries; this closes F0.
Resolve every selected source and effective-state binding, retain candidate source posture and record implementation/reviewer assignments.
Compare the refreshed snapshot with the sources used by P01-P05; unchanged bindings permit adapter work, while relevant drift invalidates evidence and triggers replan/reproof.
Document each schema/API field's mapping to the accepted formal types and meanings; the three-kind companion carrier retains the frozen v2 coverage boundary.
Reject malformed input and preserve identities, exact ordered pairs and qualifier shapes; state parser, hashing and host runtime assumptions explicitly.
Receipt replay succeeds against the captured baseline.
Include an inhabited valid model and failing pair, qualifier, reference, digest and weakened-proof cases.
Demonstration reuses the proved Lean reference checker; any host projection is separately aligned and its trust boundary remains explicit.
Review all L0 predecessor evidence and unresolved assumptions.
Either accept the named slice or narrow it explicitly; do not call the full registry verified.
Every selected relation kind resolves to exact content and effective-state evidence.
Recompute measured coverage and retain provenance for all selected records.
Every selected kind has an explicit supported, unsupported or unresolved carrier classification.
Keep immutable schemas intact; test the excluded-kind rejection as a coverage mismatch.
Imported kind and relation-specific pair counts match the captured snapshot.
Establish correspondence between source declarations, normal form and checker predicates.
Check target versions, evidence types and role/scope constraints where the supported semantics require them.
Record every unresolved reference meaning as an explicit unsupported obligation.
All selected records are accounted for and all supported checks are exercised.
Unsupported semantics remain visible; no declaration-level coverage is called complete semantic proof.
Repeated replay of identical inputs produces the same semantic result and identity.
Each relevant graph, registry, profile, rule, evidence or proof dependency change invalidates affected results.
All L1 tasks have accepted evidence and every unsupported semantic item is visible.
Authorize only the named baseline/profile for the following extension analysis.
Classify every changed semantic field and exact source identity.
Separate selected-data compatibility, invariant preservation and model conservativity.
Each supported change profile generates its complete required obligations.
Submitted evidence may discharge obligations but cannot choose or shrink the required set.
Report existing-data compatibility separately from a general theorem.
Verify quantified preservation under stated profile assumptions; unsupported general claims remain open.
Chosen use cases have nonempty models with verified axioms.
A model-conservativity claim covers every base model with an expansion leaving the old reduct unchanged, for the supported profile.
Show selected-data status, preservation status and conservativity status separately.
Rule-changing readiness remains pending until I06; unsupported obligations remain visible.
Accept scoped extension readiness only when every hard obligation for that scope is discharged.
Record the L3 handoff containing required rule obligations; G2 does not depend on their future discharge.
Define exact targetVersion, effect, scope and epoch matching for protected facts.
Rules introduce no fresh identities or external facts; independently justified existing admissions are allowed.
Verify rule identity, substitutions and every premise at each step.
Prove generic certificate soundness; distinguish a valid derivation from completeness of the closure.
Show closure contains the initial facts and all rule consequences and has no unexplained facts.
Prove finite termination and the adequacy needed for scoped negative non-derivability claims.
Check all protected identities including version, effect, scope and epoch.
Prove the boundary generically or use checked complete closure for explicitly bounded negative claims.
A reported countermodel satisfies the theory and the negation of the specific implication.
Separate semantic non-entailment, profile non-derivability and failed bounded search.
Each required rule soundness, closure, lineage and non-entailment obligation has correctly scoped evidence.
Recompute impact and invalidation for changed rules and theory dependencies.
All L3 predecessors have accepted evidence for the named inference profile.
Review exact negative-claim interpretations and the retained trust boundary.
Each command has explicit input identities, supported profile and failure behavior.
No single success Boolean collapses execution, currentness and theorem evidence.
Audit theorem identity and full required statement against the obligation.
Control toolchain, imports and submission isolation; declare remaining parser/runtime trust.
Verify source, profile, graph, rule, evidence and proof dependency identities.
Compute readiness from the required set and scoped verdicts; theorem-only bindings cannot represent bounded-search success.
Exercise valid proposals and representative semantic, proof and freshness failures.
Diagnostics identify the obligation, offending relation and next actionable step.
A changed baseline between review and simulated application forces fresh checking.
Keep the candidate recommendation distinct from human authority and actual admission.
Pilot covers supported positives, soundness/protected-boundary negatives, incompatible changes and workflow failures.
Human reviewers assess normative meaning and diagnostic usefulness separately from machine proof validity.
Audit that each layer retained predecessor guarantees and closed its promised obligations.
State supported profiles, proof boundaries, owner decisions and remaining limitations; record a human use recommendation.
